function.arguments: {"finding": "The email campaign was not randomly assigned — it was deliberately targeted at loyal customers, who have a higher baseline conversion rate. This creates a confounding: the difference in conversion rates between channels is not due to the campaign type, but due to the differing customer segments. Comparing raw conversion rates without adjusting for customer segment would misattribute the effect.", "implication": "The raw difference in conversion rates (email minus paid_search) is not a valid estimate of the campaign effect. function.name: note_finding
